name: consumer-reports-mcp
description: Consumer Reports ratings as structured tools, using your own membership. Works without one.
long_description: Ratings, reliability, prices and specs for 346 Consumer Reports product categories and 7,095 car model-years, read straight from CR's own pages and API into typed tool results. Works immediately without an account: prices, specs, reliability surveys, CR Recommended and within-group ranking are public; Overall Scores are null until you connect your membership. To connect it, just ask — a browser window opens on CR's own sign-in page, you sign in there, and the server keeps only the resulting session cookie. It never sees or stores your password.

session_cookie.title: Session cookie (optional)
session_cookie.description: Leave this empty and ask Claude to connect your membership instead: a browser window opens on Consumer Reports' own sign-in page and the server keeps only the session cookie. Fill it in only if no browser window can open on this machine — paste the 36-character `hash` cookie from a signed-in browser. Anything set here overrides what the in-conversation sign-in stores.
